issue_context.title: Merge config-file labels and kubernetes into the RRDHOST.
issue_context.body:
* Merge the two linked lists, so that user-defined labels take precedence over the kubernetes labels.
* Acquire the lock in RRDHOST.
* Replace the old list.
* Release the lock and clean up the old list.
comments: It should probably be a new lock, cause this lock is being called at a potentially higher level for readers, for a different purpose. It can lead to deadlocks or priority inversion. It's not straightforward to use the host lock.
